'''Bugs''' are an enemy found in [[the Mines]]. 80 cave insects (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
They fly up and down or left and right in a fixed path. They will ignore the Player and will only follow the same path until slain.

==Strategy==
Simply hit them from the side and stay out of their direct path.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.6|Changed Monster Eradication Goal for cave insects from 125 to 80.}}
